response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA IS NOT NULL AND UA >= 3.9 GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS average_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS average_aptt_minus_pt FROM patient_averages

assumptions.assumption: The UA cutoff selects records with UA at or above 3.9. The request does not specify which side of the cutoff to use.
